basic_info.description: Must see bright & modern 2BD 2BA condo with views & private balcony! This unit is the first 2BD resale in one of Dogpatch's newest (2020) and most popular buildings with a comfortable layout & luxury touches. The kitchen features upscale Miele appliances, gorgeous marble countertops, custom Italian cabinets, Kohler fixtures, & spacious island w/ seating. Enjoy morning sun & amazing Dogpatch views from the adjacent living room & balcony, perfect for an outdoor breakfast to experience San Francisco's sunniest neighborhood. Bedrooms are conveniently separated by the living room for privacy, & the primary includes a spacious ensuite spa-like bathroom, complete with Kohler fixtures and marble countertops & walls. This condo offers high ceilings, smart home technology, & engineered floors throughout. Designed by Woods Bagot, 2177 Third is luxury living that features curated amenities like a landscaped center courtyard, private gym, rooftop terrace, pet spa, lounge, & co-working space. With a walk score of 92, you're steps away from Crane Cove Park, coffee shops & popular restaurants, Dogpatch Boulders, Caltrain, Chase Center, Muni, Restoration Hardware, the future Pier 70 development, and more! Building allows short-term rentals for maximum of 60 days.
